regenerate: bun install && bun run build && node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --config vitest.quality.config.ts tests/quality/photos-parity.contract.test.ts  # the oracle for contracts/tools/export-photos-parity.ts; then bun run format && git diff --exit-code contracts/apps/photos
why: The bundle is generated from the v0 tree by contracts/tools/export-photos-parity.ts, whose emitter and oracle is tests/quality/photos-parity.contract.test.ts: with CENTRAID_WRITE_CONTRACTS=1 it writes these four files, and without it it rebuilds them from the live v0 handlers and asserts equality — so 'the fixture passes in v0 too' is one command, not a second suite. rows.json and queries.json are canonicalised in ONE pass over ONE vault, so an id names the same row in both and crates/apps/photos/tests/parity.rs compares ids and order, not shapes.
design_why: The outputs carry partyHueValue / identityInitials / figureTone from packages/design, which has no Rust home until design/ lands (D-1020-D3-9). Comparing the arithmetic without them would mean editing a generated fixture.
orderWhy: Those three statements order by core_party.display_name, which SQLite compares under BINARY collation and v0 renders under localeCompare. For ASCII names the two agree; for a non-ASCII roster they do not, so the case is compared as a SET (D-1020-D3-6).
phases: One case is marked phase:"unswept" — the storage answer read before the two sweeps ran. Every other case, and every row, is the swept state (D-1020-P1).
sweeps: No command writes blob_custody_rollup or media_asset_phash.cluster_id: the generator runs v0’s own refreshCustodyRollup and recomputeDuplicateClusters once before the compared read.
